propositions: Replace per-job boto3/SSM/region key lookup with startup-only source validation, accepting exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY, before queue/worker/network/workspace creation.
Copy validated key to process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file permissions, never modify or delete deployment source, and observe replacement only after process restart.

Thread immutable context-local OpcertSigner (signer, principal, push policy) through both job producer chains (completion and plan-review signing) instead of patching process-global environment state.
Remove opcert application runtime dependency on SSM/boto3/AWS_REGION by materializing key via fetch-secrets.sh before container start and bind-mounting as read-only file with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH.

Prove context-local signer isolation under concurrent and timed-out jobs, stable startup signer across process lifetime, and both out-of-opcert_service producer chains resolving from injected binding (not os.environ) when service-supplied.

Maintain Ed25519/DSSE algorithm, trust roots, producer envelope persistence, and workspace push invariants unchanged; preserve developer-local env/genesis resolution for standalone close/review-plan callers.
